document.about: Statistics Bureau of Japan, Family Income and Expenditure Survey 2025, summary. Page 4 lists the year's events under headings as items opened by the katakana middle dot; the dot also parts words inside lines (`所得・消費関係`).

checks.issue: The katakana middle dot was no bullet: consecutive items merged, up to nine to a paragraph.

holds: 政府による備蓄米の放出を開始（３月）
